description: The algorithm: rule order, AND short-circuit, STATIC/DEFAULT, type mismatch, unknown keys, the user shape, splits (buckets 0 and 99, 0% and 100% options, seed != key, missing and empty percentage attribute at rule and flag level), segments, prerequisites (chain, cycle, depth), prototype names.

suites.name: rule order, AND short-circuit, STATIC and DEFAULT

cases.name: first condition false: the second is not evaluated (no warning for the missing plan)
first condition true, second soft miss
first condition soft miss stops the rule
null default skips the type check
integer setting accepts a fractional number default
number setting accepts an integer default
json setting takes a string default
custom without the attribute falls back to the top level
custom: null falls back to the top level
custom.plan empty is missing (no fallback to the top level)
seed != key: the seed decides (user-2 under seed new_checkout)
number percentage attribute is hashed as its text
flag level: missing identifier skips the split
flag level: empty identifier skips the split (no bucket for "")
flag level: no user skips the split
flag level: missing custom percentage attribute (identifier present)
rule level: missing identifier skips the rule, the next rule serves
rule level: empty identifier skips the rule
rule and flag level share the hash (same option for the same user)
not_in, missing attribute: soft miss (not a match)
not_in with a false first condition matches
not_in: first true, second missing is a soft miss
hashed segment condition: the context is the segment's seed
hashed segment condition: hashed with the setting key does not match
